name: Aeriana's Apothecary
desc1: An assundry of vials and beakers full of liquids of all colors and
desc2: smells line the shelves here.  Some bottles are stoppered, some are
desc3: left open precariously.  A stove unlike any you've seen before sits in
desc4: the middle of the room with a merry fire burning inside and pots left
desc5: boiling on top of more than a dozen burners.
